onSuccess: Save accessToken in memory (recommended) or local state.

onFailure: Display the error message returned by the API.

whenToCall: Call this API automatically whenever any protected API returns HTTP 401.
The browser automatically sends the HttpOnly refresh token cookie.
Do not send an Authorization header.
onSuccess: Replace the old accessToken with the new one.
onFailure: Redirect the user to the login page.

whenToCall: Call when the user clicks the Logout button.
onSuccess: The backend clears the refresh token cookie automatically.
Redirect the user to the login page.

whenToCall: Call when the user selects 'Logout from all devices'.
onSuccess: The backend deletes every refresh token for this user.
The backend clears the current refresh token cookie.
Redirect the user to the login page.
notes: All other logged-in devices will be signed out automatically when their current access token expires and they try to refresh it.
